```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"A new Republican administration will patiently rebuild an international coalition opposed to Saddam Hussein and committed to joint action.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A new Republican administration will insist that Iraq comply fully with its disarmament commitments.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A new Republican administration will maintain the sanctions on the Iraqi regime while seeking to alleviate the suffering of innocent Iraqi people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A new Republican administration will react forcefully and unequivocally to any evidence of reconstituted Iraqi capabilities for producing weapons of mass destruction.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Iraq Liberation Act, passed by Congress and signed by the president in 1998, has the clear purpose of assisting the opposition to Saddam Hussein.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration has used an arsenal of dilatory tactics to block any serious support to the Iraqi National Congress.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Iraqi National Congress is an umbrella organization reflecting a broad and representative group of Iraqis who wish to free their country from the scourge of Saddam Hussein's regime.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the full implementation of the Iraq Liberation Act, which should be regarded as a starting point in a comprehensive plan for the removal of Saddam Hussein and the restoration of international inspections in collaboration with his successor.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans recognize that peace and stability in the Persian Gulf is impossible as long as Saddam Hussein rules Iraq.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
